# BCR LeadBook: Install on Android + Quick Guide

File: **BCR-LeadBook-1.0.0.apk** (about 59 MB). Works on Android 7.0 or newer. No internet or account needed.

## Install (about 2 minutes)

1. **Copy the APK to your phone**: send it to yourself by WhatsApp, email or Google Drive, or connect the phone by USB and copy it into *Downloads*.
2. **Open the file** on the phone (Files / Downloads app, or tap it in WhatsApp/Gmail).
3. If Android says *"For your security, your phone isn't allowed to install unknown apps from this source"*, tap **Settings**, switch on **Allow from this source**, press Back, then tap **Install**.
4. If *Google Play Protect* shows "App not scanned" or "Unknown developer", tap **More details → Install anyway**. This appears because the app is installed from a file, not from the Play Store.
5. Tap **Open**. On the Welcome screen tap **Get started**.
6. The first time you save a follow-up with a reminder, tap **Allow** when the phone asks about notifications.

**Updating later:** install the newer APK over the old one; your data stays.
**Do not uninstall** the app unless you have made a backup: uninstalling deletes all records.

If the phone has been set to save battery aggressively (Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Huawei, Samsung "sleeping apps"), open *Settings → Apps → BCR LeadBook → Battery* and choose **Unrestricted**, so reminders arrive on time.

## Quick guide

**After a meeting (under 5 minutes)**
1. Home → **Add Lead / Meeting**.
2. Type the **company name**. This is the only required field.
3. **Add the person you met** (name is enough). Pick a **lead quality** (Hot / Warm / Cold / Future) and optionally a **target month**.
4. **Add Product** for each policy (Medical, Motor, Property, Marine, Liability, Other). Set the expiry date if you know it. Leave it blank if you don't.
5. Type your notes: **Meeting Summary**, **Personal & Rapport Notes** (hobbies, coffee, family), **Company Trivia**.
6. **Next action**: type it, tap a day (Mon–Fri, Tomorrow, Next week…), keep **Remind me** on (9:00 AM by default).
7. Tap **Save**. A green "Saved" message confirms it. Interrupted? Your work is kept as a draft and offered on the Home screen.

**Before the next call**: Leads tab → tap the company → **Pre-call** tab shows who to call (Call / WhatsApp / Email buttons), the next action, last meeting notes, rapport reminders and policy expiries. **Add Meeting** adds a new dated entry and never overwrites old notes.

**Every morning**: **Follow-ups** tab → Today / Upcoming / Overdue. Tap the circle to complete. The ⋮ menu: Reschedule, Snooze (tomorrow or a week), Edit, Delete.

**Renewals**: Home → Upcoming renewals → See all. Filter by line (e.g. Medical) and period.

**Finding clients**: Leads tab → search by company, contact name, phone (with or without +971 / leading 0) or any word from your notes. Use Filters and Sort for quality, month, insurance line, follow-up status.

**Mistakes**: deleted something? Tap **Undo** within a few seconds. Saved a client twice? Company page → ⋮ → **Merge into another company**.

## Protect your data

Your records are stored **only on this phone**. If the app is uninstalled or the phone is lost or reset, they are gone.
**Settings → Create backup** (do it weekly): choose where to save the file (Google Drive, email to yourself…). Restore with **Settings → Restore from backup file** on the same or a new phone.
**Settings → Export to CSV** gives spreadsheets for Excel/Google Sheets; private rapport notes are included only if you tick the box.
Backup and CSV files are not password-protected: keep them private.
